answers.core: it's not strictly about assets, but about version control with the fundamental Resource class, so i think it'd be better in core.
answers.workaround: this could be worked around with a script to format the resource file before git committing.  it would not be a simple script for most users to build, since the .tres files are not syntactically hierarchical, and it could potentially be run often (while iterating on terrain design), so i'd argue for not using a script.

title: Annotation for export to allow breaking array elements with newlines in resource files
